case_title.quote: RAJA GOUNDER & ANR. V. STATE OF TAMIL NADU

number_of_accused.reason: Two appellants, the brothers of the deceased.

accused_gender.quote: the deceased and the appellants were brothers
accused_gender.reason: The accused are brothers, so male.

victim_gender.quote: PW.1 the first informant, the wife of the deceased
victim_gender.reason: The victim is a husband, so male.

accused_victim_relationship.quote: the deceased and the appellants were brothers... strained on account of a land dispute

evidence_type.quote: no discrepancy vis.-a-vis. the ocular and medical evidence

aggravating_circumstances.reason: No aggravating circumstances are formally noted.

trial_court_outcome.quote: two Courts have found against the appellants
trial_court_outcome.reason: Conviction under s.302 is implied; the sentence is not given.

high_court_outcome.quote: Crl. A. No. 573 of 2001... two Courts have found against the appellants
high_court_outcome.reason: The High Court affirmed the conviction.

final_outcome.quote: We are thus not inclined to interfere in this appeal. Dismissed.
final_outcome.reason: The appeal was dismissed, so the conviction stands.

neutral_facts.quote: the incident had happened at 10.00 p.m. at a little distance from the house of the deceased
neutral_facts.reason: Accurate and neutral, with no court outcome revealed.

physical_harm.quote: eight injuries had been detected during the post-mortem

premeditation_planning.reason: The court made no finding on premeditation.

motive.quote: relations between the parties were strained on account of a land dispute and this was the motive
motive.reason: A land dispute is stated as the motive.

key_evidence_accepted.quote: absolutely no reason to doubt the evidence of PW.1
key_evidence_accepted.reason: PW.1's testimony, consistent with the medical evidence.

witness_credibility.quote: this is a common tendency in fratricides

post_offence_conduct.reason: No post-offence conduct of the accused is described.

legal_representation.quote: K. Sarada Devi for the Appellants. S. Thananjayan for the Respondent.

investigation_status.quote: the FIR had been lodged after 13 hours
investigation_status.reason: The FIR was lodged; later stages are not stated.

procedural_irregularity.quote: delay in the lodging the FIR had been explained
procedural_irregularity.reason: The court found the delay explained, so no lapse is noted.

prosecution_argument.reason: The State's arguments are not recorded.

defence_argument.correct_value: FIR delayed 13 hours without explanation, allowing a false story; PW.2 (sister) not produced; no independent witness; FIR mentioned two injuries but post-mortem found eight.
defence_argument.quote: PW.2 the sister of the deceased and the appellants who had been cited as witness had not been produced as a witness
defence_argument.reason: The mother is wrongly said to be not produced; she appeared as a defence witness. Only the sister was not produced.

legal_principle_applied.quote: independent witnesses would not ordinarily be available
